instructions: Each item in plans is one dated announcement from this changelog or release-notes page, newest first. Include at most the 15 most recent items. date: the announcement date as YYYY-MM-DD. If the entry shows no year, take it from the month heading (for example 'Nov 5' under 'November, 2026' becomes 2026-11-05). title: a short headline for the announcement, as written on the page. If one date has several announcements, use the most important one. category: one word, for example model, api, pricing, deprecation or other. summary: one short sentence in English that tells a developer what changed, at most 200 characters. url: the link to this announcement's own page if the page shows one, otherwise an empty string. Skip entries that have no title.
